review_candidates.title: Senior SAP Technical Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose The Senior SAP Technical Specialist is a hands-on technical expert responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining custom SAP solutions across ABAP programming, system integrations, and business process automation. This role plays a critical part in ensuring the reliability and performance of the SAP landscape while actively contributing to the organization’s SAP S/4HANA migration roadmap. The successful candidate will take technical ownership of assigned systems and modules, collaborate closely with functional consultants and business stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement in SAP technical capabilities. Key Responsibilities 1. ABAP Development & Custom Programming Design, develop, test, and maintain custom ABAP programs, including reports, interfaces, forms (Smart Forms / Adobe Forms), and enhancements. Implement user exits, BADIs, BAPIs, and enhancement spots in compliance with SAP development standards. Conduct code reviews and enforce best practices for ABAP development quality, performance, and maintainability. Develop and maintain custom Fiori/UI5 applications aligned with business requirements where applicable. 2. System Integrations Design and implement end-to-end integration scenarios using IDoc, RFC, BAPI, REST/SOAP APIs, and file-based methods. Manage SAP middleware connectivity (e.g., SAP PI/PO, CPI, or equivalent integration platforms). Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve interface failures, ensuring business continuity and SLA compliance. Collaborate with external vendors and internal teams to define technical integration requirements and specifications. 3. Business Process Automation Identify repetitive manual processes and propose automation opportunities using SAP scripting, background jobs, and workflow tools. Develop and maintain batch job scheduling, workflow definitions, and automated data processing routines. Support Robotic Process Automation (RPA) initiatives integrated with the SAP landscape. 4. SAP Reporting & Data Extraction Develop complex ALV reports, interactive reports, and data extraction programs for business analytics and compliance needs. Support SAP BW/BI data extraction objects including data sources, extractors, and custom InfoObjects where required. Optimize existing reports for performance, accuracy, and usability based on business feedback. 5. SAP HCM Technical Support Provide technical development support for SAP HCM modules including Payroll, Time Management, and Personnel Administration. Develop and maintain HR forms, payroll schemas/rules configurations, and HCM-specific interfaces. Assist in SAP SuccessFactors integration and HCM data migration activities. 6. Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for technical issues, system errors, and performance degradation. Respond to and resolve Incidents and Service Requests within agreed SLA timeframes. Conduct ABAP debugging, system trace analysis, and performance profiling (runtime analysis, SQL trace). 7. SAP S/4HANA Migration Readiness Participate in SAP S/4HANA readiness assessments, including custom code remediation and simplification list analysis. Contribute to the conversion of legacy ABAP code to be compatible with HANA-optimized, CDS views, and AMDP. Support testing phases (unit testing, regression testing, UAT) for migration workstreams. 8. Documentation & Knowledge Management Maintain comprehensive technical documentation including functional/technical specifications, runbooks, and change logs. Contribute to the internal knowledge base and support knowledge transfer to junior team members. Ensure compliance with the organization’s change management and SDLC processes. Required Technical Skills Core SAP ABAP Skills Advanced ABAP programming: Object-Oriented ABAP (OOA), Procedural ABAP, Classes & Interfaces Reports: ALV Grid/List, Interactive Reports, Drill-down Reports Forms: Smart Forms, Adobe Interactive Forms (ADS) Enhancements: User Exits, BADIs, Customer Includes, Implicit/Explicit Enhancement Spots Data Dictionary: Tables, Views, Structures, Domains, Data Elements, Lock Objects Performance Optimization: Runtime Analysis, SQL Trace, ABAP Profiler, secondary index design Integration & Middleware IDoc (Inbound & Outbound): Message Types, Process Codes, Partner Profiles RFC (Remote Function Calls): Synchronous, Asynchronous, tRFC, qRFC Web Services: REST/SOAP API development and consumption File-based Interfaces: FTP/SFTP, batch input, legacy data migration SAP PI/PO or Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) exposure is an advantage SAP HCM Technical Payroll schemas and rules configuration and debugging Time Management: Work schedules, absence/attendance types, time evaluation HR Forms and HR-specific BAPIs/RFCs S/4HANA & Modern SAP Technologies Core Data Services (CDS Views) and ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 development basics HANA-specific SQL and performance considerations SAP Custom Code Migration Tool (CCMT) experience is a plus Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of formal education. Experience 3 to 6 years of hands-on SAP ABAP development experience in a production environment. Proven track record of delivering custom development objects across at least two SAP functional modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, HCM). Experience in a SAP support and maintenance environment, managing tickets and change requests. Exposure to at least one end-to-end SAP implementation or upgrade project is preferred. SAP S/4HANA project experience (greenfield, brownfield, or selective data transition) is a strong advantage. Certifications (Preferred) SAP Certified Development Associate – ABAP with SAP NetWeaver SAP Certified Development Associate – SAP S/4HANA Customizing Any additional SAP module or integration certification is a plus Competencies & Soft Skills Analytical Thinking: Ability to break down complex technical problems and propose structured solutions. Communication: Clear and concise communication with both technical peers and non-technical business stakeholders. Ownership & Initiative: Proactively takes responsibility for assigned systems and tasks with minimal supervision. Collaboration: Works effectively within cross-functional teams including functional consultants, project managers, and vendors. Attention to Detail: Thorough in testing, documentation, and code quality to minimize production incidents. Continuous Learning: Keeps up to date with SAP innovations, S/4HANA roadmap, and emerging integration technologies. Adaptability: Comfortable managing multiple priorities and shifting focus in a dynamic IT environment.
